description: An outbound artifact that constitutes a LEGAL ACT (court filing / postulation, pleading / 準備書面, formal notice / 内容証明, demand or representation letter) transmitted through the etzhayyim counsel-operated comms gateway (fax / email / e-filing). R0 skeleton per ADR-2605302345 §D2. CONSTITUTIONAL (G18): every legal-act artifact MUST be actuated and signed by a HUMAN lawyer licensed in the destination jurisdiction, using their own credential — etzhayyim holds NO signing key, seal or credential for any legal act (extends no-server-key ADR-2605231525). `counselActuation` is required and carries the actuating lawyer's DID + license jurisdiction + their signature reference; `actuatedByLicensedCounsel` MUST be true; the record carries NO corp-held signing-key property (those are unrepresentable at the schema layer). Non-legal-act material (scheduling, adherent-authored document delivery) does NOT use this record. The corp orchestrates; counsel acts. UPL (G14) and the lawyer monopoly on reserved activities are preserved.

destinationJurisdiction.description: ISO jurisdiction of the receiving court/party, e.g. jpn

artifactClass.description: Class of legal act. Each value is a RESERVED activity that only licensed counsel may perform (ADR-2605302200).

transport.description: Gateway transport used. Transport is a PIPE; lawfulness comes from counselActuation, not the pipe.

actuatedByLicensedCounsel.description: G18 anchor — MUST be true. A legal act with no licensed-counsel actuation is unrepresentable.

counselActuation.description: DID-bound attestation that a human licensed lawyer actuated and signed this artifact with their own credential.

counselDid.description: DID of the human lawyer licensed in destinationJurisdiction who actuated the act.

licenseJurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction of the actuating lawyer's license; MUST match destinationJurisdiction (or DE: Befähigung zum Richteramt; US: bar admission).

counselSignatureRef.description: Reference to the lawyer's OWN signature/credential on the artifact. The platform holds no signing key (no-server-key ADR-2605231525).
